title: Frobenius Coin Problem (Two Denominations)
recommendation: Prime target. Well-scoped, constructive, strong number-theory skill pack match. Excellent Mathlib contribution.
notes: Bézout's identity is in Mathlib; needs glue to representability
Chicken McNugget theorem (representability bound) is key lemma
Three+ coin case is NP-hard; strict scope to two coins only
Computational verification for specific (a, b) pairs is easy warmup
